agent.problem: Stop 2, card 16 mentions chips, a food that isn't a cookie and isn't in the passage.

rule.text: In jokes and comparisons, cookies are the only food he mentions.

agent.problem: Nothing in the earlier cards lets the baker reason out that the staff will become a serpent rather than a dove or a lamb. The blank asks for an unseen word by luck instead of testing meaning the baker can infer.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: "This time" and "the same thing" do not identify the Nile being turned to blood. The question depends on context from cards that are no longer on screen instead of saying what the magicians are supposedly unable to repeat.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
